About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

What You'll Do

Project scope/overview:

The intern will design, develop, and deploy production-ready capabilities for Airwallex’s Spend Cards and Issuing platform. The project may span card lifecycle management, spend controls, transaction visibility, APIs, or customer-facing card experiences..

Detailed Outline

Technical tasks/deliverables:

Technical design scoping: Create workflow diagrams, identify dependencies, expected inputs and outputs, and define success criteria (e.g., latency, accuracy, cost).
Feature development: Build and integrate production-ready Cards and Issuing capabilities across backend, APIs, and frontend where needed.
Testing & observability: Add automated testing and set up observability dashboards with logging, metrics, and alerts to monitor performance and reliability.
Deployment: Deploy the completed capability to production and validate it with real users.

Project Milestones

Technical design sign-off: Finalise workflow diagrams, success criteria, and technical design documentation.
MVP development: Build Cards or Issuing capability and validate key flows.
Production readiness: Complete testing, observability, and integration requirements.
Deployment and showcase: Release the capability and present the outcome to the wider Engineering team.

Expected Learning

Card issuing concepts, including card lifecycle, spend controls, and transactions
API and distributed systems design
Production engineering including testing, observability, and reliability
Frontend for customer-facing experiences
Building within a global fintech platform

Planned Role & Responsibilities

Actively participate in team standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align with engineering priorities.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners (e.g., Operations, Finance, Infosec) to understand workflow requirements and validate outputs.
Contribute to code reviews, testing, and documentation.
Deliver bi-weekly project updates and participate in mid-point and final showcases to demo project.
Design, develop, and deploy an assigned Cards or Issuing project under mentor guidance.

Outline Of Onboarding Process Steps In Team

Buddy assignment: Pair with a senior engineer/mentor for end-to-end feature lifecycle walkthrough, and weekly technical check-ins.
Tools orientation: Setup access to relevant AI and development tools
Domain familiarization: Walkthrough of identified finance operational workflows (e.g., cash reconciliation, PO approvals) with relevant domain experts

Proposed Schedule Of Review Check-ins

Monthly check-in for progress review and feedback sharing
Final Review: at 24 weeks (End-of-project showcase)

Eligibility Requirements

Able to commit to a 6 month placement period, ideally commence in Jan ‘27 through to June 2027.
Able to commit to Full Time hours for the duration of the placement.
Are a current student in Singapore, studying towards a formal tertiary qualification at a recognised university.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Desire to learn and grow with Airwallex as a technologist.

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum skills and experience for this role. The preferred skills are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Skills & Experience

Proficiency in Python, with strong software engineering fundamentals.
Ability to design and implement AI-driven systems that automate workflows and improve customer experiences.
Strong skills in system design and critical thinking, building elegant abstractions over complex patterns, especially in financial services.
Proven track record of writing clean, high-quality, production-grade code and ensuring robust interactions between services.
Experience working with production AI systems, adhering to best practices in engineering, security, and AI governance.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Proficiency in Kotlin, Typescript or Javascript.
Familiarity with MLOps practices and deployment pipelines for AI-driven products (e.g., model serving, monitoring, retraining).
Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Ray, etc.), or event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Exposure to cloud AI/ML services (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including GPU orchestration and scalable model deployment.

Application and Assessment process

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with application status changes and outcomes communicated as soon as decisions are finalised. Your patience during this process is highly appreciated.

Online technical assessment
Talent screen
Technical Interview
Hiring Manager interview

Requirements:
Please provide us with the PDF copies of your transcripts and CV outlining when you finish your studies when applying

About You

You can think on your feet - with knowledge of building platforms which resolve fast paced, ever changing success measures.
You are a team player - you enjoy working in a collaborative, innovative and customer first environment.
You are naturally curious - always asking why to better understand our customer needs.
You are a passionate problem solver - You love digging deep and brainstorming with colleagues in order to come up with the best solution for a problem

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Distinguished Tech Innovator

3Pillar warmly extends an invitation for you to join an elite team of visionaries. Beyond software development, we are dedicated to engineering solutions that challenge conventional norms. Envision you: steering projects that redefine urban living, establish new media channels for enterprise companies, or drive innovation in healthcare.

Your invaluable expertise will serve as the cornerstone in shaping the future direction of our endeavors.

This role is the primary technical authority within a client engagement, hands-on across the AI-driven delivery lifecycle (AI-DLC). The Architect owns high-level design choices, dictates technical standards, and stays directly engaged in the codebase — designing and building the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC, from requirements and code generation through testing, documentation, and release. The ideal candidate is as comfortable pairing with an AI agent on a pull request as they are presenting an architecture roadmap to a client executive.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Driven, Agentic Delivery

Design and build the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC — requirements gathering, code generation, testing, documentation, and release management.
Set technical standards for where AI-assisted approaches are trustworthy versus where human-in-the-loop oversight is required to protect quality, compliance, and client trust.
Stay hands-on in the codebase — reviewing, building, and validating AI-driven approaches against real engineering constraints — and feed findings back into 3Pillar's delivery practices.
Assess and plan the insertion of new AI/agentic tooling into existing technology stacks and client environments.

Solution Development & Pre-Sales

Partner with the Solutioning team on pre-SOW technical solutioning — shaping architecture, approach, and feasibility ahead of contract execution.
Translate client requirements into a credible technical narrative and delivery approach, bringing a point of view on where AI-driven delivery accelerates outcomes and where it introduces risk.
Contribute technical input to proposals, estimates, and SOWs, including effort, risk, and architecture tradeoffs.

Architecture & Technical Ownership

Act as the emissary of the architecture — technical owner from design to resolution of tailored solutions on cloud platforms, based on client requirements and constraints.
Partner with stakeholders to determine functional and nonfunctional requirements and business goals for a set of scenarios.
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies associated with the architecture.
Influence and communicate long-term product vision, technical vision, development strategy, and roadmap.
Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and architectural artifacts.
Design architectures that align with the DevOps culture and QA Automation practices.

Leadership & Mentorship

Active leader in the Architecture Practice community, mentoring engineers through Communities of Practice (CoPs) or on project teams, with a focus on AI-driven delivery skills.
Develop and lead the execution of a technical vision within one or more business or technical domains, with a focus on business value.

Note: 3Pillar operates proprietary delivery frameworks — including our Helix AI human-agent delivery model and our Lightwave Client Engagement SDLC. Candidates will not be expected to know these on day one, but should bring the foundational disciplines and AI-driven, agentic delivery experience that enable rapid adoption.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of experience/expertise working as a Software Architect and/or Solutions Architect, with hands-on proficiency in relevant cloud and AI/agentic delivery tooling.
Demonstrated experience embedding AI agents into the SDLC — not just using AI tools, but architecting the integration and the human oversight model that keeps them productive and accountable.
Experience contributing to pre-sales or pre-SOW solutioning — shaping technical approach, scoping, and effort estimation before contracts are signed.
High level of English proficiency required to interact with a globally-based development team.
Communicate in a clear and understandable manner with clients up to the executive level, and be able to articulate the details of the designed architecture using the appropriate level of technical language.
Natural leader with critical reasoning and good decision-making skills.
Extremely good knowledge of SDLC processes and familiarity with actionable metrics and KPIs.
Operational excellence in design methodologies and architectural patterns across multiple platforms.
Ability to work on multiple parallel projects and utilize time management and multitasking skills.
Experience leading Agile software development methodologies.
High-level design proficiency following UML / C4 / ArchiMate.
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices and tools.
Demonstrate mentorship and thought leadership to engineers and decision-makers throughout the organization.

Additional Experience Desired:

Foundational knowledge in Data Analysis/Modelling/Architecture, ETL Dataflows, and a good understanding of highly scalable distributed and cloud-native data stores.
Experience designing SaaS or highly scalable distributed applications on the cloud.
Financial management experience and ROI calculation.
Solutions Architect certification on a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?

At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity

Imagine a flexible work environment - whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach.
You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.
We're big on your well-being - as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.
Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries.
We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally.

Join us and be a part of a global tech community!

Check out our Linkedin site and Careers page to learn more about what it's like to be part of our #oneteam!

jobs.description:
At Epignosis our mission is simple yet bold: To make learning technologies accessible to every business, regardless of geography, sector, or company size. And we've been doing just that for more than two decades, empowering millions of people to grow, learn, and thrive through technology that's both powerful and affordable.

We're rapidly becoming one of Greece's largest SaaS companies, serving 12,000+ companies and 22+ million learners worldwide with solutions like TalentLMS (an award-winning cloud LMS built for simplicity), eFront (an enterprise LMS), TalentCards (a mobile app for deskless training), and TalentHR (a lightweight HRIS for people operations).

Our success is built on a team that believes that work should matter — not only to you, but to the world around you. We're looking for people who light up when solving hard problems, who care deeply about their craft, and who want to build something that genuinely helps people grow.

We're looking for exceptional junior and mid-level Software Engineers who think beyond the code, care about the products they build, and love turning ideas into polished experiences. You'll thrive here if you're self-motivated and creative, combine strong engineering judgment with product thinking, learn quickly, and have a genuine feel for great UX and high-quality software.

You'll join a team that moves at a fast pace, delivering high-quality software while making thoughtful decisions that stand the test of time. We expect strong engineering skills for your experience level and will give you the opportunity to work hands-on with AI and emerging technologies.

Your work will span everything from early prototypes to products used by tens of thousands of organizations and millions of people worldwide — directly shaping how they learn, work, and grow.

Responsibilities

As a Generalist, Product-minded Software Engineer you will:

Own product development end-to-end—from understanding the problem and shaping the solution to building, launching, and iterating
Understand and analyze user and stakeholder feedback, translating it into practical product improvements
Turn ambiguous ideas into clear priorities, focused scopes, and working prototypes
Shape exceptional UI and user experiences across the product, with attention to clarity, consistency, and craft
Build across the stack, taking on frontend, backend, integrations, and infrastructure as needed
Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope to deliver value quickly
Collaborate closely with design, product, and business teams, contributing to both what we build and how we build it
Ship reliable, intuitive experiences and own testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance
Measure how products perform, learn from real usage, and take responsibility for outcomes

Requirements

To be successful in this role you should:

Be a builder. Turn ideas into working software—and have projects to show for it
Have a feel for great software and excellent UI/UX. Notice the details that make products intuitive and enjoyable to use
Think in terms of products. Understand the user's problem, question assumptions, and help decide what's worth building
Be an exceptional engineer for your experience level.

Bonus points for:

Experience across multiple technologies and programming paradigms
Familiarity with asynchronous programming

Working in a smaller bank means broader responsibilities, wider knowledge, and the opportunity to make a real impact. We are growing fast and are looking for motivated people eager to join our teams to help transform and improve our trading and banking systems.
What makes the position interesting?

You will work on a distributed .NET platform built around C# / .NET, Domain-Driven Design and event-driven microservices.
Our services communicate through gRPC and asynchronous messaging using RabbitMQ and NServiceBus, applying patterns such as CQRS, Domain Events, Outbox, etc.
You will be involved not only in development, but also in domain modelling, technical design, architecture decisions and the continuous evolution of our distributed systems.
The platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) and uses MySQL/Aurora and DynamoDB, depending on the domain and its access patterns.
We put a strong emphasis on engineering quality, automated testing, observability and production readiness.
Infrastructure and delivery are managed through GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform.
The role offers the opportunity to work on real-world distributed systems where reliability, scalability, maintainability and domain complexity matter, rather than simply building CRUD applications.
You will not only work with interesting technologies, but also solve complex problems across three key business domains:
Banking
– everything related to payments and banking transactions.
Cards
– debit and credit card ordering and management.
Credits
– primarily our online mortgage product, Keyhome
.

Being a true team player, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues, while also being able to drive initiatives autonomously.
Transforming complex business needs into elegant and maintainable technical solutions.
Balancing engineering discipline with pragmatism.
Caring deeply about code quality, security and maintainability.
Continuously learning, both from a technical perspective and about the banking domain.

C# / .NET 8/.NET 10

Binnen Cronos bestaat namelijk niet zoiets als dé .NET job.

Er zijn verschillende bedrijven, teams en omgevingen. Daarom willen we je liever niet in één vacature proberen te duwen. We horen liever eerst jouw verhaal en kijken daarna waar binnen Cronos een interessante match kan zitten.

jobs.title: Software Engineer: Keystone Project (Machine-Verified LLM Inference)
jobs.description:
Mission

The Keystone project, an ARIA-funded collaboration between EPFL and Imperial College London, aims to build a formally-verified ML inference engine, demonstrating that AI can help make verified systems competitive with unverified systems in terms of development effort, features, and performance. Its missions include the design and implementation of verified inference components, the formalization of GPU kernel semantics, the development of AI-assisted proof engineering workflows, and the open-source release of specifications, proofs, and verified artefacts.

We seek an excellent software engineer to play a central role in turning verified research prototypes into a production-grade, high-performance inference engine. Prior experience with formal verification is welcome but not required: a strong systems engineer with the motivation to learn proof-assistant technology will thrive in this role.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Bring technical expertise in systems programming and performance engineering to support the project’s research; collaborate with the research teams at EPFL and Imperial College London
Design, implement, and maintain core components of the verified LLM inference engine, including the runtime and glue code connecting extracted verified code, GPU kernels, and drivers
Organize and manage the project’s engineering infrastructure: differential testing against reference engines (vLLM, SGLang), continuous integration for code and proofs, and performance benchmarking
Develop and maintain agentic AI pipelines for specification autoformalization, proof generation, and proof repair
Write documentation, procedures, and recommendations to ensure reproducibility of the project’s artefacts
Diagnose, prevent, and repair failures and regressions across the software stack
Analyze the security level and trusted computing base of the components we develop, and contribute to red/blue team exercises within the ARIA programme
Contribute to open-source releases and engage with their user communities

Profile

Higher degree in computer science or education deemed equivalent; experience in the field
Excellent technical knowledge of systems programming, and strong programming ability in several of: Python, C/C++, Rust, OCaml, or other functional languages
Knowledge of one or more of the following, with strong motivation to grow in the others:
GPU programming (CUDA, Triton, PTX) or high-performance computing
ML inference or serving systems (vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch internals, or similar)
Interactive theorem proving (Rocq, Lean, HOL, Isabelle, or similar) or other formal methods

Experience maintaining development tooling: build systems, continuous integration, and test infrastructure
Experience using LLM-based development tools or building agentic workflows is a plus
Mastery of English indispensable (oral and written); French is an asset but not required
Sense of priorities, integrity, and autonomy in your work
Team spirit and aptitude for conducting technical investigations and implementations; excellent ability to communicate with varied audiences, from proof engineers to systems researchers
Strong sense of service and spirit of initiative

We offer

The possibility to join a dynamic and stimulating team on a high-profile ARIA-funded project
A multicultural and academic working environment of high quality
Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
Excellent working conditions
Generous access to frontier AI models and high-performance compute
Funded travel for collaboration between Lausanne and London, and for conferences

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And In One PDF

A CV, including links to open-source contributions or representative projects where applicable.
Contact details for 3 referees.

Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un/a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python) para incorporarse a un proyecto de una compañía internacional líder en soluciones de gestión de nóminas y RRHH. Formarás parte del equipo que desarrolla una plataforma de Payroll Operations potenciada por IA: un asistente inteligente que automatiza los flujos de nómina y permite a los profesionales gestionar sus operaciones a través de una experiencia conversacional.
No es un proyecto greenfield: se espera que te incorpores rápidamente a un codebase grande y existente, entiendas cómo se conectan los sistemas y entregues dentro de los patrones y convenciones ya establecidos. La plataforma cubre todo el stack, desde micro frontends y web components, pasando por APIs REST y bases de datos relacionales, hasta agentes de IA desplegados en cloud, e integra múltiples sistemas de nómina enterprise.
¿Qué harás?

Diseñar, construir y mantener agentes de IA en Python utilizando frameworks agénticos modernos y runtimes de IA en cloud
Desarrollar y mantener APIs en .NET Core que actúan como servicios downstream de la capa de agentes
Construir e integrar micro frontends en Angular y web components en Stencil dentro de una shell application enterprise existente
Trabajar con bases de datos SQL Server: escribir queries, entender esquemas e integrarse con los modelos de datos de nómina existentes
Escribir y mantener código de infraestructura en Terraform para despliegues cloud
Integrar nuevas capacidades de agentes en sistemas legacy de nómina sin romper la funcionalidad existente
Colaborar con equipos de frontend, backend, IA e infraestructura para entregar funcionalidades end-to-end
Aplicar buenas prácticas de seguridad: trust boundaries de identidad, idempotencia, audit trails, redacción de PII y feature flags como kill switches
Contribuir a la documentación de diseño, READMEs y knowledge base del equipo

¿Qué buscamos?

5+ años de experiencia profesional en ingeniería de software, con al menos 2 años en sistemas full-stack (frontend, backend e infraestructura cloud)
IA / Agentes: runtimes de agentes en cloud (despliegue, configuración de memoria, gestión del runtime), frameworks agénticos (diseño de tools, patrones orchestrator/child agent, flujos human-in-the-loop), Model Context Protocol (MCP) en cliente y servidor, prompt engineering y patrones de diseño agénticos (state machines, HITL, intent routing)
Backend: Python 3.10+ a nivel avanzado (async, validación de datos, packaging), .NET Core / C# (APIs REST, implementación de servidores MCP) y SQL Server (esquemas, queries, stored procedures)
Frontend: Angular v15+ (module federation, micro frontends), Stencil.js, TypeScript avanzado y experiencia con design systems enterprise (librerías de componentes, tokens, accesibilidad)
Infraestructura y DevOps: Terraform (container registries, IAM, secrets management), Docker / Podman, AWS (servicios de contenedores, runtimes de IA, secrets, IAM), monorepos (NX o similar) y pipelines CI/CD
Seguridad y compliance: patrones zero-trust e identidad de tenant, diseño idempotente (claves deterministas, exactly-once), audit trails y redacción de PII, feature flags y kill switches

Perfil que encaja

Te pones productivo/a rápido en codebases grandes y desconocidos
Piensas en sistemas: puedes seguir una petición de frontend → API → agente de IA → infraestructura cloud y detectar dónde falla
Te sientes cómodo/a trabajando con sistemas legacy, no solo en proyectos desde cero
Lees antes de escribir: entiendes los patrones existentes antes de introducir nuevos
Autonomía para coger un ticket, encontrar el código relevante y entregar
Colaborador/a de bajo ego, que trabaja dentro de las decisiones arquitectónicas del equipo
Mentalidad de documentación: dejas el codebase mejor de lo que lo encontraste

Se valorará

Conocimiento del dominio de nómina o RRHH (centros de coste, estructuras organizativas, workforce management)
Experiencia con sistemas ERP o CRM enterprise legacy
Testing end-to-end / de integración (Playwright o similar)
Experiencia construyendo o integrando funcionalidades de IA conversacional o chatbots en aplicaciones enterprise
Experiencia integrando funcionalidades basadas en IA/LLMs en sistemas en producción

Nivel de inglés profesional, imprescindible (entorno de trabajo en inglés)

En InnoIT creemos que el talento se desarrolla en un entorno donde aprender, innovar y disfrutar del camino van de la mano.

Client: International Organization
Location : Based in Valencia, Spain. Selected candidate will join on remote and 2/3 days onsite per week from Valencia office as of January 2027 approx.
Daily rate : Max 310 USD

"Only candidates currently based in Valencia, Spain, or willing to relocate there at their own expense will be considered for this role. Please note that the Agency does not cover relocation costs or provide visa sponsorship."

Job Summary

The Content Division within the Information Technology Department (ITD) is seeking a contractual Systems Engineer to support enterprise content, document management, collaboration, workflow, and knowledge management platforms. The division delivers technology solutions that support content and knowledge management, communications and outreach, member and partner engagement, workflow and authoring capabilities, and selected capital projects within its portfolio.

Under the direction of the Deputy Division Chief or Platform Family Owner, the Systems Engineer will serve as a senior technical contributor for enterprise document management and integrated business applications. The role is primarily focused on hands-on development and support using Microsoft .NET technologies and SharePoint Online as a document management and collaboration platform. Key areas include solution design, application development, workflow automation, API and integration services, metadata-driven document solutions, and operational support. The incumbent will design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable solutions using ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, REST APIs, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Platform components, and Microsoft 365 services, while ensuring alignment with business requirements, security standards, and enterprise architecture. The role also includes targeted support for OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM where needed for enterprise content management and integration scenarios.

The selected candidate will be expected to:

·    Design, develop, and support enterprise applications using ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, REST APIs, and modern Microsoft development practices.
·    Develop, configure, and enhance SharePoint Online solutions as a document management platform, including document libraries, metadata models, permissions, retention support, search, forms, dashboards, and user-centric collaboration features.
·    Develop advanced customizations using SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Automate, Power Apps, and Microsoft Graph to streamline workflows and integrate SharePoint with Microsoft 365 and enterprise applications.
·    Lead integration design across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and other business systems, while applying best practices for scalability, supportability, and governance.
·    Provide targeted development and support for OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM, particularly for integrations, content management capabilities, and interoperability with enterprise document repositories.
·    Support the full solution lifecycle end-to-end, including requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, deployment, release support, and production troubleshooting.
Given the global nature of the Fund’s operations, the selected candidate may occasionally be asked to support flexible working arrangements, including shift coverage or after-hours availability for planned changes, critical releases, or priority incidents, as business needs arise.

Education & Experience
·      Educational development, typically acquired through completion of an advanced university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, plus a minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience; or a bachelor’s degree in a related field plus a minimum of ten (10) years of relevant professional experience.

·  Additionally, the ideal candidate should demonstrate:
·  Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies, including ASP.NET, C#, .NET Framework/.NET, SQL Server, Web APIs, and service-oriented integration patterns.
·  Deep technical expertise in SharePoint Online as a document management solution, including architecture, site and information design, document libraries, content types, metadata, retention considerations, search, permissions, and collaboration capabilities.
·  Demonstrated development experience using SharePoint Framework (SPFx), client-side web parts/extensions, JavaScript/TypeScript, Microsoft Graph, and REST APIs to deliver custom business solutions.
·  Strong experience developing workflow and automation solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, and Microsoft 365 integration patterns to streamline document-centric business processes.
·  Experience integrating SharePoint Online with Teams, OneDrive, Azure-based services, and other enterprise platforms to support secure content sharing, collaboration, and lifecycle management.
·  Strong knowledge of software engineering disciplines including secure coding, SDLC, source control, deployment pipelines, testing, troubleshooting, production support, and responsible use of AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar platforms.
·  Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs and supportable platform solutions.
·  Experience with OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM, especially around document repository support, integrations, metadata, permissions, and workflow capabilities, is desirable.
·  Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural, multi-project environment and respond to changing priorities.

Required technical experience includes:
·  Advanced experience in .NET development using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Web Services, and REST API development.
·  Advanced experience implementing and customizing SharePoint Online as a document management and collaboration platform.
·  Strong development knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 integration capabilities.
·  Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms to improve developer productivity while following secure coding, code review, and governance practices.
·  Working knowledge of OpenText Content Server / Extended ECM, including integrations, metadata, workflows, and enterprise content services.

Major Duties and Responsibilities
·  1. .NET Application Development & Solution Delivery
·      Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of enterprise applications using ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, REST APIs, and related Microsoft technologies.
·      Develop scalable custom solutions, components, forms, dashboards, reports, and integration services that support document-centric and business workflow processes.

Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and reusable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and operational support needs.

jobs.title: Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
jobs.description:
En Provis
seguimos creciendo y queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, una persona con experiencia trabajando con aplicaciones web y APIs, capacidad para investigar y resolver incidencias técnicas y criterio para validar que una nueva versión está realmente preparada antes de llegar a nuestros clientes.

Buscamos un perfil técnico senior que disfrute entendiendo cómo funcionan las cosas, investigando problemas y trabajando cerca tanto de clientes como de los equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Si te gusta un entorno donde puedes tocar producto, soporte avanzado, QA, APIs, despliegues y cliente, este puesto puede ser para ti.

Únete a un equipo donde tu trabajo tiene impacto real

En Provis nos apasiona la tecnología y el fitness
por eso nos especializamos en la gestión de centros deportivos y cadenas de gimnasios.
Trabajamos en un entorno SaaS B2B en el que conviven aplicaciones web, APIs, aplicaciones móviles, software de gestión, pagos, reservas, control de accesos e integraciones con múltiples plataformas externas.
Nuestro día a día requiere personas con capacidad para entender el producto de forma global, tomar ownership de los problemas y colaborar con diferentes equipos hasta encontrar una solución.
No buscamos simplemente alguien que reciba una incidencia y la traslade.
Buscamos alguien que quiera entender qué está pasando, por qué está pasando y cómo podemos evitar que vuelva a ocurrir
.

Cómo será tu día a día

Como Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, serás una de las referencias técnicas para nuestras soluciones Web y APIs.
Participarás en todo el ciclo de vida de nuestras soluciones: desde una incidencia reportada por un cliente hasta su análisis, escalado, validación de la solución y posterior despliegue.
Trabajarás estrechamente con nuestros equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas, Producto y Soporte, además de tener contacto directo con clientes cuando sea necesario.
Es un puesto amplio por diseño.
Queremos una persona que pueda desenvolverse cómodamente entre Web, APIs, troubleshooting, QA, releases y soporte técnico avanzado
.

Lo que tendrás bajo tu responsabilidad

Analizar y resolver incidencias técnicas relacionadas con nuestras aplicaciones Web, APIs e integraciones.
Reproducir problemas reportados por clientes e investigar su causa antes de trasladarlos a Desarrollo.
Trabajar con APIs REST mediante herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares.
Analizar requests, responses, códigos HTTP, autenticación, logs y diferentes comportamientos de una aplicación.
Utilizar las herramientas de desarrollo del navegador para investigar incidencias Web.
Configurar, administrar y poner en marcha nuestras soluciones Web en nuevos clientes.
Realizar configuraciones y modificaciones sobre HTML y CSS cuando sea necesario.
Participar en despliegues y actualizaciones de aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Realizar QA funcional y betatesting de nuevas funcionalidades.
Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba para aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Validar correcciones antes de su publicación.
Realizar pruebas de regresión sobre funcionalidades críticas.
Participar en el proceso de publicación de nuevas versiones y en su validación antes de llegar a producción.
Probar nuevas versiones con clientes beta y realizar seguimiento después del despliegue.
Detectar riesgos o problemas antes de una publicación y comunicarlos de forma clara.
Gestionar y hacer seguimiento de incidencias de soporte técnico N2/N3.
Asegurar que las incidencias que llegan a Desarrollo contienen la información necesaria para analizarlas y reproducirlas.
Participar en reuniones de coordinación con Desarrollo para trasladar incidencias, prioridades y necesidades del cliente.
Hablar directamente con clientes cuando sea necesario para entender o resolver un problema.
Documentar actualizaciones, procedimientos, incidencias y configuraciones.
Compartir conocimiento con el resto del equipo y ayudar a mejorar nuestros procesos de soporte, QA y despliegue.

Lo que buscamos

Experiencia profesional trabajando con aplicaciones Web
.
Buenos conocimientos de HTML y CSS
.
Conocimiento del funcionamiento de una aplicación Web: HTTP, navegador, sesiones, cookies, caché, autenticación, etc.
Experiencia trabajando o realizando pruebas sobre APIs REST
.
Manejo de herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares
.
Capacidad para utilizar DevTools y otras herramientas de diagnóstico.
Conocimientos de SQL que permitan investigar incidencias y trabajar con datos.
Experiencia investigando y resolviendo problemas técnicos.
Experiencia en QA, testing funcional, soporte técnico avanzado o validación de software.
Capacidad para estructurar y documentar correctamente una incidencia técnica.
Buena comunicación y comodidad tratando directamente con clientes.
Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y asumir responsabilidad sobre los temas que gestiona.
Mentalidad analítica, curiosidad técnica y ganas de entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

Nos encantará especialmente si además tienes experiencia en...

Entornos SaaS B2B.
Soporte técnico N2/N3 o Application Support.
Procesos de publicación y despliegue de software.
Git y procesos CI/CD.
Aplicaciones móviles.
Automatización de pruebas con Ranorex, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium o herramientas similares.
Integraciones entre diferentes plataformas mediante APIs.
Sistemas de ticketing y gestión de incidencias.
Trabajo con clientes técnicos o equipos de IT.
Inglés técnico.

Importante:
no esperamos que cumplas absolutamente todos los puntos.
Si tienes una buena base en Web/APIs, eres una persona técnica, resolutiva y con capacidad de aprendizaje, queremos conocerte.
Preferimos encontrar una gran persona con capacidad para crecer que un CV que simplemente marque todas las casillas.

¿Por qué puede ser un gran siguiente paso?

Este no es un puesto donde te limitarás a realizar siempre la misma función.
Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar de extremo a extremo:
Cliente → incidencia → diagnóstico → Desarrollo → QA → release → producción.

Eso significa:
Autonomía real.
Problemas técnicos diferentes cada día.
Contacto directo con Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Visibilidad sobre cómo funciona una plataforma SaaS compleja.
Capacidad para proponer cambios y mejorar procesos.
Posibilidad de convertirte en una referencia técnica dentro del área Web y APIs.
Participación directa en proyectos e implantaciones para algunos de nuestros principales clientes.

¿Por qué ProviSport?

Somos la empresa líder en tecnológica especializada en el sector fitness y deportivo.
Nuestro software es utilizado diariamente por cadenas de gimnasios, centros deportivos y millones de usuarios, y seguimos evolucionando nuestra plataforma, nuestras APIs y nuestras aplicaciones para acompañar el crecimiento de nuestros clientes.
Estamos en un momento en el que queremos seguir elevando nuestro nivel técnico, mejorar nuestros procesos de QA y despliegue y construir una organización cada vez más sólida y escalable.
Por eso buscamos personas que quieran aportar, cuestionar, mejorar y asumir responsabilidad
.

Qué ofrecemos

🚀 Incorporarte a una compañía tecnológica en crecimiento y con un producto consolidado.
💻 Trabajar con aplicaciones Web, APIs, mobile e integraciones reales en producción.
🧠 Un puesto con un componente técnico elevado y mucha variedad.
🤝 Contacto directo con diferentes áreas técnicas y con clientes.
📈 Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
🏡 Modalidad híbrida.
📍 Oficinas en Zaragoza.
📚 Formación continua y aprendizaje sobre producto, tecnología e integraciones.
💼 Contrato indefinido y jornada completa de lunes a viernes.

Nuestra forma de trabajar

Valoramos especialmente a las personas que toman ownership y tenga actitud positiva
.
Si algo falla, queremos entenderlo.
Si un proceso puede mejorarse, queremos cambiarlo.
Si una incidencia llega incompleta, queremos hacer las preguntas necesarias antes de escalarla.
Y si una versión no está preparada para llegar a nuestros clientes, esperamos que alguien tenga el criterio y la responsabilidad para decirlo.
Buscamos personas cercanas, profesionales, técnicas y con ganas de construir conjuntamente.

¿Te interesa?

Si te gusta trabajar con Web, APIs, QA y resolución de problemas técnicos
, y buscas un puesto en el que puedas tener impacto sobre producto y clientes, nos encantará conocerte.
Aplica directamente a través de LinkedIn y nuestro equipo se pondrá en contacto contigo.

El proceso de selección

El proceso será sencillo y directo:
Primera conversación para conocernos y explicarte el proyecto y el puesto.
Entrevista técnica con responsables del área.
Pequeño caso práctico orientado a diagnóstico Web/API y QA.
Conversación final con el equipo.

Sobre Nosotros

En Dipole RFID somos líderes europeos en soluciones transversales de identificación inteligente, IoT, trazabilidad y tecnología RFID para entornos industriales, logísticos y de cadena de suministro. Acompañarás todo el ciclo de vida del producto: comprensión de necesidades, definición funcional, seguimiento del desarrollo, validación, implantación, puesta en marcha y evolución posterior, asegurando la coherencia estratégica del roadmap.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

POSITION DETAILS

Location:
Sant Cugat del Vallès (Barcelona), Spain — hybrid.
Contract:
permanent, full-time.

At Diligent, we build Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Audit software that helps uncover fraud, waste, environmental risks, and abuse in organizations. Our collaborative R&D teams build and scale a SaaS platform using AWS technologies—delivering AI-powered solutions that support Modern Governance and drive meaningful impact.

As a Staff Software Engineer in Test, you’ll take ownership of quality assurance across an entire program, spanning multiple Scrum teams and involving both QA analysts and engineers. Your responsibility goes beyond manual and automated testing—you will define and drive quality across the full development lifecycle, advocate for shift-left principles, and enable rapid, safe delivery. In addition to your test engineering and automation expertise, you will champion AI-augmented quality practices, leveraging modern tools and governance principles to enhance testing coverage, efficiency, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Lead testing strategy and execution across complex microservices and frontend/backend architectures (AWS, .NET, Angular, APIs, etc.)

Voor een interessant en maatschappelijk relevant Digital Twin-project zijn we op zoek naar een Technisch Architect met een sterke achtergrond in DevOps en Security Architectuur.
Je komt terecht in een lopende samenwerking tussen een grote publieke organisatie en een toonaangevende IT-dienstverlener, waarin gezamenlijk wordt gewerkt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een toekomstvaste, veilige en schaalbare Digital Twin-omgeving.
Als Technisch Architect ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen architectuur, development, DevOps, infrastructuur en security. Je denkt mee over de technische koers, maar staat ook dicht bij de teams die de oplossingen realiseren. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat technische keuzes niet alleen toekomstgericht en veilig zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en beheersbaar.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van de technische architectuur van het Digital Twin-platform.
Vertalen van complexe vraagstukken naar heldere en duurzame technische oplossingen.
Samenwerken met architecten, DevOps- en developmentteams, securityspecialisten en andere stakeholders.
Bewaken van architectuurprincipes en technische standaarden.
Meedenken over integraties met bestaande systemen, GIS-, IoT- en dataplatformen.
Verder brengen van DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code en observability.
Security vanaf het begin meenemen door toepassing van Security by Design en Zero Trust.
Fungeren als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor verschillende technische en niet-technische stakeholders.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant?

Je werkt in een omgeving waarin verschillende organisaties, disciplines en expertises samenkomen. Juist de samenwerking maakt deze rol interessant: je krijgt de ruimte om vanuit jouw technische expertise richting te geven, maar doet dit samen met ervaren professionals uit verschillende vakgebieden.
Je hoeft niet alles zelf te doen. Het gaat er vooral om dat je de juiste verbindingen legt, overzicht houdt en samen met de betrokken teams tot goede technische keuzes komt.

Wat neem je mee?

Ervaring met Digital Twin, assetmanagement, GIS, IoT, sensordata of real-time dataverwerking is een mooie aanvulling.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent technisch sterk, maar krijgt vooral energie van samenwerken en verbinden. Je kunt complexe technische onderwerpen helder uitleggen, verschillende belangen bij elkaar brengen en stakeholders meenemen in jouw keuzes.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA Instruments™ is our instrumentation division, which designs advanced metrology and inspection instruments used in both R&D and production across industries and academia. Our tools—ranging from optical profilers and nano-indenters to thin film and defect inspection systems—enable precise surface and material analysis. We partner closely with customers to enable R&D, improve yield, optimize processes, and reduce production costs through innovative hardware, software and application expertise.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

As a Software Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead and grow a multidisciplinary group of software and firmware engineers who design, develop, release, and support our families of surface profiler, thin film, sheet resistance and nanoindentation measurement instruments. You will be responsible for both people leadership and technical direction spanning embedded firmware, Windows desktop applications, software architecture, and measurement and data-analysis algorithms, leveraging cutting-edge technologies and the latest advancements in software engineering and AI/ML/DL. You will partner closely with hardware, systems, product, and global engineering teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.

Responsibilities:

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software and firmware engineers—setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, conducting performance reviews, and supporting career growth
Provide technical direction and oversight across embedded firmware, Windows desktop software (C#/.NET, C++), software architecture, and measurement, data-analysis, and signal/image-processing algorithms
Own planning and execution for your team—scope and estimate work, manage schedules and priorities, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and deliver releases on schedule
Drive sound architecture and design decisions through design and code reviews, and uphold engineering standards for quality, performance, reliability, and security
Recruit, hire, and onboard top engineering talent while building an inclusive, high-performing, and collaborative team culture
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, systems, product management, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams to define requirements and align on roadmaps
Partner with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and Asia on system integration, software releases, and shared engineering best practices
Champion responsible adoption of AI/ML and AI-assisted development tools under company security policies, remove obstacles, and foster root-cause analysis and continuous improvement in process and product quality

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree (required) + significant relevant experience; Master’s or advanced degree (desired) + relevant experience in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, or Physics, including people-management or technical-lead experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and grow software and firmware engineering teams and to deliver complex products on schedule.
A solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals—software architecture, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, event-driven and multithreaded design, testing, and debugging—sufficient to guide technical decisions across the team.
Technical breadth across the team’s technology areas, including experience with:
Microsoft .NET and C# for Windows desktop applications
C and C++ programming, including embedded firmware
Software architecture for complex, real-time systems
Measurement, data-analysis, or signal/image-processing algorithms
Source code control (Git), modern development practices, and software design and coding standards

Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence peers, interdisciplinary engineering groups, customers, suppliers, and senior leadership, including delivering clear technical and program presentations
Adept at managing and collaborating with teams across the US, Europe, and Asia
Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills with a systematic, data-driven approach to leading teams

Preferred:

Experience managing multidisciplinary teams spanning firmware/embedded, desktop application, and algorithm development
Experience in the semiconductor, metrology, inspection, or scientific-instrument domain
Experience with Agile/Scrum and modern software development lifecycle and release management
Experience delivering AI/ML capabilities in products
Experience improving engineering processes, diagnostics/observability, and software quality for complex systems

Travel:

Occasional travel may be required to KLA headquarters, customer sites, or other business locations. Travel is expected to be less than 10% of working time.

Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role

What we will offer you?

KLA’s benefits package includes:

Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme, car allowance and life assurance

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (required) + 8yrs relevant experience; Master’s or advanced degree (desired) + 6yrs experience in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, or Physics, including at least 2–3 years of people-management or technical-lead experience.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

Founded by engineers, Databricks has started a multi-year journey to build the best Lakehouse Platform. For this we are building on top of a great foundation but our goal is to go further to build dramatically better products. We want to revisit every component to provide our customers with the fastest, easiest to use and most secure data platform for all their data workloads.

Lakebase enables teams to deliver applications faster with an optimized database developer experience, integration with the lakehouse, and simplified operations. It provides a managed Postgres transactional layer for application state and workloads that combine operational data, analytics, and AI. You'll join as one of the founding engineers to build out both the Lakebase product and our London presence.

Below Are Some Example Teams You Can Join

Lakebase Platform Reliability
: Constantly evolving Lakebase Reliability. That includes cross-functional infrastructure, observability, SLI/SLOs definition and measurements, as well as achieving higher operational efficiency without the need for humans-in-the-loop (both internal and customer-facing), via building AI-powered automation and services

Lakebase Manager (LBM):

Build and operate the central control plane that owns the core logic for Lakebase — database creation and deletion, wake-up and suspend, maintaining computes on hot standby, HA failover, and more. LBM interacts with every Lakebase component — storage, compute, proxy, and console — managing the full database lifecycle at scale with a focus on reliability.

Lakebase Proxy:

Build the heart of the Lakebase data path — the network edge that every customer touches. The proxy handles all client connections and transfers every byte of query traffic, serving every data protocol: Postgres, HTTP, WebSockets, and Data API. We route and manage large volumes of concurrent connections, solving load balancing, authentication, and data access at high throughput. We focus on performance, observability, and reliability to ensure the data path is fast and resilient.

The Impact You Will Have

Our backend teams span many domains across our essential service platforms. For instance, you might work on challenges such as:

Problems that span from product to infrastructure including: distributed systems, at-scale service architecture and monitoring, workflow orchestration, and developer experience.
Build reliable, secure and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, GCS, Azure Blob Store.
Develop product features that empower our customers to easily store and access their data.
Solve reliability problems related to Lakebase.
Actively find causes of downtime and systematically improve or remove root causes.
Help the org define SLIs, meet SLOs, and drive long-term reliability improvements.

What We Look For

BS degree (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field.
8+ years of production level experience in one of: Java, Scala, C++, or similar language.
Experience developing large-scale distributed systems.
Experience working on a SaaS platform or with Service-Oriented Architectures.
Knowledge of SQL.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. new_jobs.description:
ABOUT CAPGEMINI

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

As an AI Platform & Site Reliability Engineering Managing Consultant, you will help clients design, build and scale secure, reliable and operationally effective AI platforms. You will combine expertise in platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability and intelligent operations to help organisations move from isolated AI experimentation to production-grade, enterprise-scale AI services.

You will work with technology, engineering, operations and business leaders to establish the platforms, operating models, governance and reliability practices required to run AI-enabled services safely, effectively and at scale. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will shape client strategy while leading delivery teams and helping grow our AI Platform & Reliability Engineering capability.

This Will Include:

AI Platform Strategy & Architecture: Assess, define and evolve enterprise AI platform architectures, covering LLM and agentic frameworks, AI gateways, model lifecycle management, data platforms, MLOps/LLMOps foundations and integration patterns. Support clients in evaluating build, buy and hybrid approaches aligned to business needs, risk appetite and operational requirements.
AI Platform Engineering & LLMOps: Design and implement scalable AI platform capabilities including model deployment pipelines, prompt and model management, evaluation frameworks, AI observability, platform automation and operational guardrails. Enable reliable and repeatable delivery of AI services from experimentation through to production.
Reliability Engineering & SRE: Establish SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, resilience engineering and reliability governance. Help clients shift from reactive operations to data-driven reliability management while balancing reliability, innovation and delivery velocity.
Observability & Operational Intelligence: Define observability strategies across applications, platforms and AI workloads using metrics, logs, traces and telemetry. Establish operational insight models that support proactive decision-making and enable advanced capabilities including anomaly detection, event intelligence, noise reduction and predictive operational analytics.
AI Operations & Service Reliability: Apply reliability engineering principles to AI-enabled services, monitoring AI-specific failure modes such as data quality degradation, hallucination patterns, token consumption, agent reliability and model performance drift. Implement controls, feedback loops and automated guardrails to ensure AI services remain secure, trusted and cost-effective.
Responsible AI & Platform Governance: Design and embed AI governance frameworks, model risk controls, compliance measures and responsible AI practices that address security, regulatory and ethical requirements while supporting innovation and adoption at scale.
Automation & Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to reduce operational complexity and toil through engineering-led automation, intelligent workflows and AI-enhanced operational practices. Help clients improve scalability, consistency and operational performance while reducing manual effort.
Client Advisory & Transformation Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, CDO and Engineering leadership stakeholders, shaping platform strategies, operating models, vendor selections and transformation roadmaps. Lead consulting teams and workstreams from assessment and strategy through implementation and scale-up.

YOUR PROFILE

Essential Experience

Proven experience designing, delivering and operating cloud-native, platform engineering, AI platform or reliability engineering solutions within complex enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of AI platform architectures including LLMOps, MLOps, agentic AI frameworks, model lifecycle management and AI operational controls.
Experience establishing and scaling SRE practices including observability, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management and reliability engineering.
Strong understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, regulatory requirements and model risk management.
Experience implementing observability strategies using modern monitoring, telemetry and operational analytics platforms.
Demonstrated ability to advise senior stakeholders and lead multidisciplinary transformation programmes.
Experience working across hyperscaler ecosystems including Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
Proven ability to balance business outcomes, user needs, engineering constraints and operational requirements when shaping platform strategies.

Desirable Experience

Experience with AI observability, model monitoring, AI governance tooling or AI platform operations.
Experience of platform engineering, DevSecOps, automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Experience developing propositions, leading bids and supporting business growth activities.
Active participation in AI, SRE, platform engineering or cloud communities.

Certifications (Desirable)

Azure AI Engineer Associate
Azure Solutions Architect Expert
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Cloud Architect
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
SRE Foundation or SRE Practitioner
Relevant observability platform certifications (Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk etc.)

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant#levels-of-national-security-clearance)

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership and experienced consulting management, where you can learn from them, challenge them, and accelerate your hands-on experience, delivery capability and industry insights.
You’ll learn how we write compelling client propositions, structure, and lead high-profile transformation, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution.
Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery.
We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google and Microsoft.
Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed.
We hold monthly showcases of our initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

As Part Of Your Role You Will Also Have The Opportunity To Contribute To The Business And Your Own Personal Growth, Through Activities That Form Part Of The Following Categories:

Business Development
– Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.

Internal Contribution
– Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.

Learning & Developmen
