YOUR ROLE

As an AI Platform & Site Reliability Engineering Managing Consultant, you will help clients design, build and scale secure, reliable and operationally effective AI platforms. You will combine expertise in platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability and intelligent operations to help organisations move from isolated AI experimentation to production-grade, enterprise-scale AI services.

You will work with technology, engineering, operations and business leaders to establish the platforms, operating models, governance and reliability practices required to run AI-enabled services safely, effectively and at scale. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will shape client strategy while leading delivery teams and helping grow our AI Platform & Reliability Engineering capability.

This Will Include:

AI Platform Strategy & Architecture: Assess, define and evolve enterprise AI platform architectures, covering LLM and agentic frameworks, AI gateways, model lifecycle management, data platforms, MLOps/LLMOps foundations and integration patterns. AI Platform Engineering & LLMOps: Design and implement scalable AI platform capabilities including model deployment pipelines, prompt and model management, evaluation frameworks, AI observability, platform automation and operational guardrails. Enable reliable and repeatable delivery of AI services from experimentation through to production.
Reliability Engineering & SRE: Establish SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, resilience engineering and reliability governance. Observability & Operational Intelligence: Define observability strategies across applications, platforms and AI workloads using metrics, logs, traces and telemetry. AI Operations & Service Reliability: Apply reliability engineering principles to AI-enabled services, monitoring AI-specific failure modes such as data quality degradation, hallucination patterns, token consumption, agent reliability and model performance drift. Implement controls, feedback loops and automated guardrails to ensure AI services remain secure, trusted and cost-effective.
Responsible AI & Platform Governance: Design and embed AI governance frameworks, model risk controls, compliance measures and responsible AI practices that address security, regulatory and ethical requirements while supporting innovation and adoption at scale.
Automation & Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to reduce operational complexity and toil through engineering-led automation, intelligent workflows and AI-enhanced operational practices. Help clients improve scalability, consistency and operational performance while reducing manual effort.
Client Advisory & Transformation Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, CDO and Engineering leadership stakeholders, shaping platform strategies, operating models, vendor selections and transformation roadmaps. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

new_jobs.title: Engineering Manager — Change Systems
new_jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Organization

Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) helps keep Netflix's engineering fleet healthy, secure, and current. We design and run the large-scale migration and modernization campaigns that move the fleet forward — from dependency upgrades to infrastructure-level changes — so that individual engineering teams don't have to absorb that toil on their own.

About The Team And The Role

The Change Systems team owns the platforms that make fleet-wide change possible at Netflix. It gives engineering teams across the company a unified way to scope, launch, automate, and validate change at scale — from routine dependency updates to complex, multi-service migrations — with as little manual toil as possible.

The platform already operates at significant scale: over 100 engineering teams run change activities across thousands of repositories, and usage continues to grow year over year. The team's mandate is expanding to match — pushing automation further using AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration. The goal is to make the majority of change at Netflix low-to-no-effort for the engineers on the receiving end, while giving the teams driving that change the tooling, telemetry, and adoption data they need to move with confidence.

You will lead the engineers who build and operate this platform, based in Warsaw. This is a team with deep end-to-end ownership: they run their own on-call, design the automation and orchestration layers directly, and are pushing the platform toward AI-driven code transformation as a first-class capability rather than a one-off tool.

End-to-end Ownership Translates Into Several Responsibilities

from a technical perspective, acting like a System Architect, driving technical architecture and component integration;
from a product perspective, wearing the Product Manager hat for Campaigns and defining the vision and strategy for the Campaigns experience;
from a partnership and stakeholders' perspective, identifying needs, incorporating feedback, aligning across the organization, creating partnerships to drive impact
from a leadership perspective, acting like a Change Agent and Advocate supporting the overall organization in shaping the mindset and approach around Campaigns (change at scale) in the agentic world;

The platform is at an inflection point, which makes this role particularly important:

From tooling to platform. Change Systems has built strong point solutions for individual campaigns. The next step is composable, declarative abstractions that every part of the platform — and the teams building on top of it — share a common foundation rather than one-off automation.
From manual campaign design to AI-assisted execution. GenAI-driven code transformation, contract-based validation, and batch orchestration are becoming core to how campaigns get executed — across code transformation, CI, testing, and delivery to production.
From reactive to metrics-driven prioritization. Using historical campaign completion data to predict bottlenecks, target specific automation investments, and measure adoption and adherence rather than simply responding to inbound requests.
From isolated campaigns to a coherent customer experience. Close technical alignment is required with Source Management, Continuous Integration, Resilience Engineering and Delivery Engineering and Security so that campaign recipients experience one coherent platform, not a patchwork of tools.

What You Will Do

Be a thought partner to Organization Champions, Campaign Managers, Campaign Recipients, and engineering leadership in setting the vision, strategy, and adoption path for fleet-wide change management as a platform capability.
Own the technical architecture direction for a composable, declarative platform that generalizes beyond any single migration use case.
Serve as a credible technical advisor to your team, helping engineers navigate ambiguous, cross-domain technical decisions — and act as the team's escalation point for novel campaigns that span multiple technical domains.
Drive AI-first ways of working across the team: treat AI-assisted code modification as core infrastructure, and advance agent-assisted engineering practices with the code review, change-risk management, testing, and evaluation rigor required to run them safely at scale.
Raise the team's rigor around impact — define meaningful adoption and adherence metrics, use historical campaign data to predict and target automation investment, and prioritize based on evidence rather than only inbound requests.
Own the operational excellence of a platform relied on across the fleet, including on-call responsibilities, telemetry and dashboards for fleet health, and feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.
Communicate complex technical and product tradeoffs clearly, in writing and verbally, to influence decisions across a broad set of stakeholders — including technical executives, SREs, and security incident commanders.
Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of engineers; challenge them to expand their ownership and grow their impact beyond their immediate scope.
Foster a strong culture of accountability, and build an inclusive team environment where every engineer feels empowered to contribute at their best.

What We Are Looking For

Experience building and operating platform systems that support large-scale, business-critical use cases, including on-call responsibilities and resilient, well-instrumented services.
Strong technical acumen in distributed systems and developer platforms, with the ability to move between architecture and implementation detail, and to represent technical decisions credibly to partner teams.
Experience building and leading inclusive engineering teams, attracting and retaining talent, and fostering a culture where individuals take ownership while contributing to shared outcomes.
Strong long-term strategic thinking and a platform mindset — able to define a technical vision for composable, extensible systems and connect it to broader organizational goals.
Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders across engineering, product, and security.
Rigor in decision-making: comfortable reducing ambiguity through a mix of data, stakeholder input, constructive dissent, and targeted experiments.
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering, with a clear point of view on how to adopt GenAI-driven code transformation and agentic tooling safely at scale.
Strong technical writing skills — design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion.

Nice to Have

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns.
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems.
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations.
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context.
Experience designing platforms where agents, not just humans, are first-class consumers — including provisioning and debugging through APIs rather than a UI.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes).

new_jobs.title: Junior German-speaking Fullstack Developer – Integration Team
new_jobs.description:
About Parkster

At Parkster, we want to be the best at what we do. We build smart, user-friendly software, strive for top-tier customer service, and strive to be a fantastic employer. We have offices in Lund and Munich, and our services are live in around 1,400 locations across Sweden, Germany, and Austria, used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

This doesn’t stop us from chasing ambitious growth targets, quite the opposite. Together with municipalities, property owners, and private partners, we create parking solutions that are seamless today and sustainable for tomorrow.

Our engineering team currently counts just over 20 people. Many of us have years of experience, but nobody has lost the drive to solve tough problems and learn new things together.

About The Role

We have just launched a brand-new team dedicated entirely to our product integrations. These are the connections we build or configure alongside our customers and partners. Some of the most common examples are automatic license plate recognition (ANPR) cameras, EV charging, and data/statistics collection.

Initially, the team's hands-on focus will be building the integrations needed right now. Long-term, the goal is to empower others to quickly and easily configure standard integrations on their own, without needing to involve developers.

The same applies to monitoring the health of our existing integrations. To start with, you will dive in to investigate and resolve ongoing issues. We have already started visualizing this data and will set up smart alerting so that the right information reaches the right person at the right time. It’s going to be an exciting journey!

We are looking for a Junior Fullstack Developer with a solid technical foundation, high drive, and a good commercial mindset to join this team.

We are based out of our Lund office and truly value the sense of community at our workplace. While you have the flexibility to work from home a day or two a week, we hope you appreciate face-to-face collaboration and casual chats by the coffee machine just as much as we do!

Who Are You?

To thrive in this role, we believe you are someone who:

Has a solid technical foundation. Our systems are large and complex. To get up to speed, you need a broad technical baseline and a genuine desire to understand how things work under the hood. An appropriate foundation is either a masters in a related field, and/or at least two years of working experience as a developer.
Enjoys working with both people and machines. Integrations always involve another party, so it matters that you enjoy meeting potential customers and partners, both in person and online, and that you don't mind picking up the phone to get an answer or push an implementation forward.
Focuses on business value and user impact. We love building top-class technical solutions, but we always prioritize what creates the most value. The ability to evaluate, prioritize, and adjust your focus is crucial.
Is always curious to learn. You happily share your knowledge and actively seek feedback from your peers to keep growing.
You speak German and English (Swedish is a plus too!). A major part of our new integrations will be set up with partners in Germany and Austria, so you need to be able to effortlessly participate in and drive meetings with German speakers. Additionally, while our engineering language is English, our Lund office breathes Swedish, so if you can handle the daily fika chat or are eager to learn, you'll fit right in!

What We Work With

We don't hold any prestige when it comes to specific programming languages, we simply choose the best tool for the job. Today, our daily life looks roughly like this:

Backend: Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot.
Frontend: TypeScript, React, and Next.js (we also have Web Components and some legacy JSP).
Platform/Infrastructure: Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Databases: BigQuery, MongoDB, and MySQL, among others.

If you already know this stack, or if you have the drive and sharpness to pick it up quickly, you’ll love it here.

What We Offer

We are a team driven by building software that makes a real difference. Today, we are over a hundred colleagues across our offices in Sweden and Germany, enjoying close collaboration and a great community across borders and departments.

As an international growth company, we offer a fast-paced environment with plenty of room to grow. Here, you become part of a forward-thinking organization with short decision-making paths and a flat, ego-free culture.

Parkster offers great benefits, including an occupational pension, health insurance, a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag), and above all, a workplace where we have serious fun at work.

Sounds like a match?

We recruit continuously and look forward to hearing from you. Send us your CV and a cover letter telling us a bit about what drives you.

Please note: Since it’s summertime, our response times might be a bit slower than usual over the holidays. We’ll be back in full force starting August 10th, and we appreciate your patience in the meantime!

Have any questions? Contact the hiring manager David Göransson via david.goransson@parkster.com or the Head of Development Martin Gunnarsson via martin.gunnarsson@parkster.com.

OM ROLLEN // MAKE IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS

Wise IT söker en erfaren Manhattan Scale Consultant / Solution Architect för ett projektbaserat konsultuppdrag hos kund. Uppdraget innebär att genomföra en oberoende granskning av kundens befintliga Manhattan Scale-implementation ur ett funktionellt, tekniskt, arkitekturellt och operativt perspektiv.

Målet är att bedöma lösningens nuläge och molnberedskap, identifiera förbättringsområden samt lämna rekommendationer som stärker stabilitet, prestanda, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltningsbarhet.

Du kommer att granska den övergripande lösningsarkitekturen och bedöma designen utifrån etablerade arbetssätt. I ansvaret ingår att identifiera arkitekturella risker, teknisk skuld och onödiga anpassningar samt utvärdera lösningens skalbarhet, motståndskraft, förvaltningsbarhet och operativa stabilitet. Du tar även fram rekommendationer kring arkitekturella förbättringar och modernisering.

En central del av uppdraget är att analysera integrationerna mellan Manhattan Scale och omgivande system, däribland Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, EDI, API:er, middleware, transportsystem och andra verksamhetsapplikationer. Granskningen omfattar integrationsarkitektur, dataflöden, gränssnittens tillförlitlighet, felhantering, övervakning, loggning, synkronisering och operativ support.

Du granskar även Manhattan Scale-konfigurationen och lageruppsättningen samt bedömer systemprestanda, bakgrundsbearbetning, integrationer och operativa flaskhalsar. Utifrån analysen identifierar du möjligheter att förbättra lösningens prestanda och skalbarhet.

Den funktionella granskningen omfattar lagerprocesserna från inbound till outbound, inklusive lagerstyrning, lagerverksamhet och systemkonfiguration. Du utvärderar implementationen utifrån Manhattan Scale best practices och identifierar processförbättringar samt återkommande operativa problem.

nulägesanalys
lösnings- och arkitekturgranskning
granskning av Manhattan Scale-konfigurationen
integrationsanalys
prestandaanalys
bedömning av molnberedskap
risk- och gapanalys
prioriterad förbättringsroadmap
rekommendationer för målarkitektur
sammanfattning för beslutsfattare
kunskapsöverföring.

Uppdraget är ett projektbaserat konsultuppdrag med en uppskattad längd på cirka 4–8 veckor.

DIN PROFIL // YOU BRING THE EDGE

För att lyckas i uppdraget behöver du ha:

Gedigen erfarenhet av Manhattan Scale WMS.
Erfarenhet av att implementera eller granska Manhattan Scale-lösningar i större verksamhetsmiljöer.
Djup kunskap om lagerverksamhet och WMS best practices.
Erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och integrationer i komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer.
Erfarenhet av att integrera Manhattan Scale med ERP-system.
Erfarenhet av API:er, EDI, middleware och distribuerade system.
Erfarenhet av att genomföra health checks, rotorsaksanalyser och tekniska bedömningar.
Förståelse för molnarkitektur och moderniseringsstrategier.
Stark analytisk förmåga.
God förmåga att dokumentera analyser och rekommendationer.
Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt med olika intressenter.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av integrationer mellan Manhattan Scale och Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV.

OM ORGANISATIONEN // CULTURE WITH REAL CHARACTER

Uppdraget genomförs hos en kund med en befintlig Manhattan Scale-implementation och en systemmiljö som omfattar ERP, EDI, API:er, middleware, transportsystem och andra verksamhetsapplikationer. Kunden söker ett oberoende perspektiv på lösningens funktion, teknik, arkitektur, drift och framtida utveckling.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Bli med på laget og vær med på å forme fremtidens subsea-sensorteknologi!

Hos Siemens Energy på Bømlo vil du arbeide med avanserte sensorsystemer som støtter kritisk energiinfrastruktur. Som en del av et tverrfaglig ingeniørteam vil du utvikle programvare innen innebygde systemer, produksjonsverktøy, automatisering og digitale løsninger som har direkte innvirkning på hvordan produktene våre utvikles, produseres og brukes.

En glimt av din hverdag

Vi utvikler programvare og hardware som optimaliserer produksjonsprosessene våre. Dette inkluderer automatisering, logging, testsystemer og datadrevne forbedringer av prosesser.

Du vil få muligheten til å lære hvordan hele systemet fungerer, fra innebygd programvare og sensorhardware til backend-tjenester og frontend-applikasjoner. Nysgjerrighet og læringsvilje er minst like viktig som tidligere erfaring.

I hverdagen vil du jobbe på tvers av fagområder og ha tett samarbeid med produksjonen, hardwareingeniører og andre interne interessenter. Derfor er det viktig med fysisk tilstedeværelse på arbeidsplassen. Hjemmekontor er mulig i noe grad, men dette er primært en stilling med arbeidssted på Bømlo.

Hvordan du vil gjøre en forskjell

Innebygd programvare for subsea-sensorer

Utvikling i C og tilhørende verktøy. Programvaren kjører direkte på sensorene våre og er avgjørende for produktenes ytelse og pålitelighet.

Interne administrasjons- og automatiseringsløsninger

Vi utvikler og vedlikeholder interne systemer, inkludert et egenutviklet ERP-system og løsninger for dokumenthåndtering. Disse systemene integreres med plattformer som SAP og Teamcenter og bidrar til digitalisering på tvers av organisasjonen.

Produksjonsverktøy og digitalisering av fabrikken

Programvaren du utvikler bidrar til å sikre kvalitet, pålitelighet og ytelse i avansert subsea-sensorteknologi som brukes over hele verden.

Vår teknologistack inkluderer blant annet C, C#, TypeScript (Svelte), Rust og tilhørende rammeverk.

Hva du bringer med deg

Vi ser etter en ingeniør som:

Kan programmere selvstendig
Har et solid fundament innen programmering og programvareutvikling
Tar eierskap til oppgaver og følger dem helt i mål
Kommuniserer tydelig og samarbeider godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter
Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å lære på tvers av fagområder
Arbeider strukturert og følger etablerte programvareprosesser

Utdanning innen informatikk, programvareutvikling eller tilsvarende er en fordel, men relevant erfaring og praktiske ferdigheter verdsettes like høyt.

Erfaringsnivå

Stillingen er rettet mot erfarne ingeniører. Samtidig er vi åpne for å investere i dyktige junioringeniører som ønsker å bygge en langsiktig karriere hos oss og gradvis ta større ansvar.

Hvem er Siemens Energy?
Hos Siemens Energy er vi mer enn bare et energiteknologiselskap. Med omtrent +100 000 dedikerte ansatte i mer enn 90 land utvikler vi energisystemene for fremtiden, og sikrer at det økende energibehovet til det globale samfunnet blir møtt på en pålitelig og bærekraftig måte. Teknologiene som skapes i våre forskningsavdelinger og fabrikker driver energiovergangen og utgjør grunnlaget for en sjettedel av verdens elektrisitetsproduksjon.

Vårt globale team er forpliktet til å gjøre bærekraftig, pålitelig og rimelig energi til en realitet ved å presse grensene for hva som er mulig. Vi opprettholder et 150-års arv av innovasjon som oppmuntrer vår søken etter mennesker som vil støtte vårt fokus på avkarbonisering, nye teknologier og energitransformasjon.

Finn ut hvordan du kan gjøre en forskjell hos Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Vår forpliktelse til mangfoldet
Skap energi. Vær deg selv.

Heldigvis for oss, er vi ikke alle like. Gjennom mangfold, inkludering og respekt skaper vi energi. Vår samlede kreative energi kommer fra mer enn 130 nasjoner. Siemens Energy verdsetter deg og den du er, uavhengig av din etniske bakgrunn, kjønn, alder, religion, identitet eller funksjonsnivå. Vi skaper energi til samfunnet, hele samfunnet, og vi gjør ikke forskjell på folk.

Vi utfører bakgrunnssjekk som del av vår rekrutteringsprosess.

Telefon: +47 900 25 616

new_jobs.title: AI Architect
new_jobs.description:
As of 2 September 2025, Vivicta, former Tietoevry Tech Services, now operates as a standalone company under our new brand. We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at https://www.vivicta.com

Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.

Vivicta is building AI solutions that create measurable impact today while preparing enterprises for the next generation of intelligent, agent-based systems.

We are looking for an AI Architect
to help design and deliver production-grade AI solutions for enterprise customers. This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who understands both the technical depth of modern AI systems and the practical realities of deploying them securely, reliably, and at scale.

You will work across LLM applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, classical machine learning, cloud-native platforms, and responsible AI governance. The right candidate knows when to use generative AI, when traditional ML is the better fit, and how to design solutions that are robust, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.

This role also requires strong customer-facing skills. You should be able to explain complex AI concepts and architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, contribute to RFPs and proposals, and help customers understand how AI can solve real business problems.

What You’ll Be Working On

Designing and delivering enterprise AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, classical ML, and agentic architectures.
Building applications where AI systems can reason, plan, use tools, retrieve knowledge, and support complex business workflows.
Shaping scalable AI architectures across platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS, GCP, and multi-cloud environments.
Establishing best practices for MLOps and LLMOps, including CI/CD, evaluation, observability, monitoring, model governance, and lifecycle management.
Helping customers make informed platform and architecture choices based on security, compliance, data residency, scalability, and business value.
Contributing to Vivicta’s AI capabilities, including our work with secure, compliant, and sovereign AI environments.
Embedding responsible AI principles into every solution, with attention to GDPR, the EU AI Act, enterprise security requirements, and customer-specific governance frameworks.
Creating reusable reference architectures, technical accelerators, and delivery practices that help teams build AI solutions faster and more consistently.
Supporting sales, pre-sales, and proposal work by translating customer needs into credible AI solution concepts, architectures, and delivery plans.
Acting as a senior advisor to customers, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

Strong communication skills in both Finnish and English. This is required for customer-facing work.
At least 8 years of experience in AI, machine learning, data platforms, cloud architecture, or software architecture roles.
A strong track record of designing and delivering production-ready AI or data-driven systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation, and AI application development.
Experience with agentic frameworks or orchestration patterns, such as Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent approaches.
Strong expertise in at least one major cloud AI/ML platform, such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
Good understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, observability, and production operations.
Ability to design end-to-end architectures, evaluate trade-offs, document decisions, and guide teams from concept to production.
Ability to explain technical concepts, solution architectures, risks, and business value clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience contributing to sales, pre-sales, RFP responses, proposals, workshops, or customer presentations.
Understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data residency, and responsible AI requirements in enterprise environments.
Interest in sovereign AI, secure AI platforms, and emerging enterprise AI operating models.

Why this role matters

This role is about more than building AI models or prototypes. It is about helping enterprises adopt AI responsibly, securely, and at scale.

As an AI Architect at Vivicta, you will influence how Nordic enterprises design and deploy AI systems that create real business value. You will help customers move from experimentation to production, shape future-ready AI platforms, and contribute to the development of secure, compliant, and scalable AI capabilities.

You will be part of a team working at the intersection of architecture, engineering, cloud platforms, governance, customer advisory, and business transformation.

We offer you

We offer you professional growth, meaningful work, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application!

Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. Hope to hear from you soon!

We conduct background checks for all final candidates, and some roles may require security clearance during hiring or later—always handled within local legislation and with care and confidentiality.

Vivicta is committed to diversity and welcomes applicants of all genders, ages, abilities, ethnicities, orientations, beliefs, and backgrounds. 

Vivicta declines calls from recruitment companies.

new_jobs.title: Value Architect, Data & AI
new_jobs.description:
A senior data and AI expert who turns data into value: advising our key clients, shaping our offering, and helping grow the business.

Do you enjoy working with modern data & AI solutions? Are you equally at home acting as a trusted advisor to clients while driving sales and shaping the offering? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help organizations turn data into real business value, from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert working across two roughly equal dimensions of the role. One half is client-facing. You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on where unified data and AI-first delivery turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in time-to-value, quality, and decision speed, and which human-and-AI team should deliver them. The other half builds the offering and the pipeline. You shape what we sell, architect the sale, and support our teams to win, and you may take ownership of specific offerings of your own. One morning you frame the business case with a CDO. That afternoon you review a data architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with and shape

Everything we do runs on an AI-first approach: a spec-driven, agentic operating model where a small embedded team owns the product lifecycle end to end. The Nortal AI Kit sits underneath it, with skills, templates, workflows, and agents that turn business ideas and needs into AI-ready specifications, and those into enterprise-grade platforms, data products, and AI applications. This is not a separate service. It is how we deliver, and it runs through each of our core offerings:
Data & AI Platform Modernization:
unified, governed data and AI foundations that make data AI-ready at scale, delivered for example as a Databricks or Microsoft Fabric lakehouse and an AI platform such as Microsoft AI Foundry or M365 Copilot.
Edge Platform Modernization:
unified, cloud-native, edge architecture for real-time, sovereign data and AI across many sites from one control plane, compliant by design and delivered for example as Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes at the edge.
Data, AI & Analytics use cases:
data, AI, and analytics applied to business processes to create value. Built on the data and edge platforms, these use cases turn trusted, unified data into measurable outcomes: higher uptime and throughput, sharper demand and risk forecasting, lower energy use and cost, better customer targeting, and safer, more compliant operations.

You start with these, help evolve them, and shape new offerings as the market moves.

What You Will Do

The role has two roughly equal sides.

Advise our clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor
. Work with senior client stakeholders (CDOs, heads of data, business owners) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Own the architecture.
Influence architecture and design decisions so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every pipeline yourself, but you can steer an AI-first approach and stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the sale. Stay hands-on enough to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case from proposal to production.

Build the offering and win the work
Support sales.
Lead discovery and qualification (backlog size, handovers per request, time-to-delivery, platform readiness), handle the hard objections with evidence, and shape the proposal, including the solution approach, the work estimate (often AI-augmented), and the customer value case. Always close on a concrete next step, whether a workshop, a discovery project, or full-scale delivery.
Develop the offering
. Turn engagements into reusable assets and named offerings, sharpen the land-and-expand packaging, and feed proof points, patterns, and prompts back into the offering.
Help us grow.
Support growing the business, take ownership of selected offerings, mentor others, and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so growth is never bound by one person’s bandwidth.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in data and technology with business acumen
(Data Architect, Principal Consultant, Head of Data or Analytics, Solution Lead, or similar), with ten or more years across both the customer and consulting sides.
A track record of winning new, high-value customers
and engagements and growing existing accounts, with real ownership of business growth, not just delivery.
Consultative mindset.
You lead with the customer’s problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
AI-native ways of working.
Fluent use of modern AI tools (such as Claude Cowork, Claude Design) and coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Kiro). You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.
Platform familiarity.
Comfortable with modern cloud and data stacks such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Value-case construction.
An instinct for where AI and unified data remove cost rather than shift it, and the ability to turn that into a case a CFO and a CDO both believe. A commercial mindset, and ownership of your pipeline.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of at least one industry we serve (manufacturing, energy, the public sector, retail, or similar) is a strong plus, and helps you speak the customer’s language from day one.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach both technical teams and C-level stakeholders. German is an asset.

Why join us

Shape it, don’t inherit it.
You help build and grow the offering alongside the Head of Data & AI, rather than maintaining one someone else froze in place. It is an evolving, entrepreneurial role with room to leave your mark.
Work at the AI-first frontier.
Agentic, spec-driven data delivery and platform modernization applied to real enterprise problems, not perpetual pilots.
A community, not a silo.
A network of architects from several disciplines and transformation consultants behind you, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you sell.
Sell from strength.
Own your pipeline and your patterns, with the weight of a trusted partner to governments and Fortune 500 companies across Europe, the GCC, Latin America, and North America. Microsoft named us in its Industrial AI Partner Guide, one of a select group of integrators trusted to deliver industrial AI at scale.

Salary range
: 7000-9000€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

new_jobs.title: Erfaren C#/.NET-udvikler til opbygning af integrationsplatform
new_jobs.description:
Har du solid erfaring med C#, .NET og udvikling af integrationer i Azure? Kan du omsætte tekniske krav og arkitekturprincipper til robust kode, veldesignede API’er og løsninger, der fungerer stabilt i drift? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega.

Du får en central teknisk rolle i udviklingen af Roskilde Universitets Azure-baserede integrationsplatform. Du skal udvikle integrationer og fælles komponenter samt bidrage til en robust og sammenhængende applikations- og integrationsarkitektur. Samtidig får du mulighed for at fastlægge teamets standarder for kode, unittest og dokumentation inden for vores fælles arkitekturprincipper og i dialog med teamet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets øvrige udviklere, faglig koordinator og testmanager samt med arkitekter, drift og projektledere.

Roskilde Universitet er i gang med en omfattende digital modernisering. Vi udskifter og opgraderer centrale systemer og flytter løbende integrationer til en fælles integrationsplatform. Det stiller krav til robuste API’er, genanvendelige komponenter, sikker dataudveksling og løsninger, der kan overvåges, driftes og videreudvikles.

Om Digital og dit team

Du bliver en del af Digitaliseringsenheden med 16 medarbejdere. Enheden hører under Digital, Roskilde Universitets centrale afdeling for IT, digitalisering, informationssikkerhed, samt projekt- og procesmetoder. Digital har ca. 70 medarbejdere.

Din daglige base bliver udviklingsteamet, som består af fem udviklere, en fagkoordinator samt en testmanager. Teamet deltager i udviklingsprojekter og varetager samtidig den løbende vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af universitetets systemer, integrationer og platforme.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine hovedopgaver i jobbet er at: Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer, fælles komponenter og referenceimplementeringer på vores integrationsplatform.
Omsætte behov, krav og arkitekturprincipper til tekniske designs og robuste løsninger samt videreudvikle principperne for udviklingsområdet i samarbejde med teamet og arkitekterne.
Fastlægge og forankre teamets udviklingsprincipper og standarder samt løfte den tekniske kvalitet gennem code reviews, automatiseret test, dokumentation, faglig sparring og videndeling.
Videreudvikle vores CI/CD-pipelines og automatisere build, test og deployment.
Bidrage gennem hele DevOps-forløbet fra analyse og udvikling til idriftsættelse, overvågning og fejlhåndtering.
Anvende og videreudvikle teamets brug af AI-baserede udviklingsværktøjer til kodning, test, dokumentation og fejlsøgning.

Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, softwareudvikling eller lignende. Du kan også have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem flere års relevant erhvervserfaring.
Vi forventer at du har: Solid erfaring med C#, moderne .NET og objektorienteret softwareudvikling.
Erfaring med design, udvikling og deployment af integrationer i Azure, gerne med Azure Functions og App Service.
Erfaring med API’er, dataflows og datakontrakter samt databaser, SQL, JSON og XML.
Erfaring med Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD-pipelines og automatiserede unit- og integrationstest.
Evne til at omsætte krav og arkitekturprincipper til robuste løsninger, begrunde tekniske valg og dokumentere kode, snitflader og tekniske beslutninger.
Erfaring med AI-understøttet softwareudvikling og evne til at kvalitetssikre værktøjernes kode og forslag.
Lyst til at dele viden og løfte den tekniske kvalitet sammen med resten af teamet.
Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder
Eventbaserede integrationer og robuste meddelelsesmønstre, herunder idempotens.
Containerbaserede løsninger og IAC, f.eks. Docker eller Terraform,
Identitets- og adgangsstyring i Azure, herunder Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault eller OAuth 2.0.
Entity Framework, GraphQL

Vi lægger vægt på, at du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan sætte dig ind i komplekse tekniske problemstillinger. Du samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af fagligheder og kan forklare tekniske valg til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger. Du skal kunne formulere dig på dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten med indplacering efter gældende overenskomst som specialkonsulent eller anden relevant overenskomst. Der er herudover mulighed for at forhandle tillæg. Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med ansættelse 1. december eller snarest herefter.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 43 og 44.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til enhedschef Sonni Hansen på +45 6195 1227 eller sonni@ruc.dk.

Jf. direktivet om løngennemsigtighed fremgår lønintervallerne for de forskellige jobkategorier på Roskilde Universitet her.

Ansøgning

Søg stillingen på https://ruc.dk/ledige-stillinger-pa-roskilde-universitet/
Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

1. Motiveret ansøgning
2. CV
3. Dokumentation for uddannelse

Ansøgningsfristen er 14. oktober2026.

Materiale modtaget efter fristens udløb vil ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Roskilde Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge hos os.

Ansættelsesprocessen på Roskilde Universitet kan omfatte en risikovurdering som et værktøj til at identificere potentielle risici forbundet med nyansættelser, der sikrer arbejdspladsens sikkerhed, compliance og integritet.

Distinguished Tech Innovator

3Pillar warmly extends an invitation for you to join an elite team of visionaries. Beyond software development, we are dedicated to engineering solutions that challenge conventional norms. Envision you: steering projects that redefine urban living, establish new media channels for enterprise companies, or drive innovation in healthcare.

Your invaluable expertise will serve as the cornerstone in shaping the future direction of our endeavors.

This role is the primary technical authority within a client engagement, hands-on across the AI-driven delivery lifecycle (AI-DLC). The Architect owns high-level design choices, dictates technical standards, and stays directly engaged in the codebase — designing and building the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC, from requirements and code generation through testing, documentation, and release. The ideal candidate is as comfortable pairing with an AI agent on a pull request as they are presenting an architecture roadmap to a client executive.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Driven, Agentic Delivery

Design and build the architecture that embeds AI agents across the SDLC — requirements gathering, code generation, testing, documentation, and release management.
Set technical standards for where AI-assisted approaches are trustworthy versus where human-in-the-loop oversight is required to protect quality, compliance, and client trust.
Stay hands-on in the codebase — reviewing, building, and validating AI-driven approaches against real engineering constraints — and feed findings back into 3Pillar's delivery practices.
Assess and plan the insertion of new AI/agentic tooling into existing technology stacks and client environments.

Solution Development & Pre-Sales

Partner with the Solutioning team on pre-SOW technical solutioning — shaping architecture, approach, and feasibility ahead of contract execution.
Translate client requirements into a credible technical narrative and delivery approach, bringing a point of view on where AI-driven delivery accelerates outcomes and where it introduces risk.
Contribute technical input to proposals, estimates, and SOWs, including effort, risk, and architecture tradeoffs.

Architecture & Technical Ownership

Act as the emissary of the architecture — technical owner from design to resolution of tailored solutions on cloud platforms, based on client requirements and constraints.
Partner with stakeholders to determine functional and nonfunctional requirements and business goals for a set of scenarios.
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies associated with the architecture.
Influence and communicate long-term product vision, technical vision, development strategy, and roadmap.
Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and architectural artifacts.
Design architectures that align with the DevOps culture and QA Automation practices.

Leadership & Mentorship

Active leader in the Architecture Practice community, mentoring engineers through Communities of Practice (CoPs) or on project teams, with a focus on AI-driven delivery skills.
Develop and lead the execution of a technical vision within one or more business or technical domains, with a focus on business value.

Note: 3Pillar operates proprietary delivery frameworks — including our Helix AI human-agent delivery model and our Lightwave Client Engagement SDLC. Candidates will not be expected to know these on day one, but should bring the foundational disciplines and AI-driven, agentic delivery experience that enable rapid adoption.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of experience/expertise working as a Software Architect and/or Solutions Architect, with hands-on proficiency in relevant cloud and AI/agentic delivery tooling.
Demonstrated experience embedding AI agents into the SDLC — not just using AI tools, but architecting the integration and the human oversight model that keeps them productive and accountable.
Experience contributing to pre-sales or pre-SOW solutioning — shaping technical approach, scoping, and effort estimation before contracts are signed.
High level of English proficiency required to interact with a globally-based development team.
Communicate in a clear and understandable manner with clients up to the executive level, and be able to articulate the details of the designed architecture using the appropriate level of technical language.
Natural leader with critical reasoning and good decision-making skills.
Extremely good knowledge of SDLC processes and familiarity with actionable metrics and KPIs.
Operational excellence in design methodologies and architectural patterns across multiple platforms.
Ability to work on multiple parallel projects and utilize time management and multitasking skills.
Experience leading Agile software development methodologies.
High-level design proficiency following UML / C4 / ArchiMate.
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices and tools.
Demonstrate mentorship and thought leadership to engineers and decision-makers throughout the organization.

Additional Experience Desired:

Foundational knowledge in Data Analysis/Modelling/Architecture, ETL Dataflows, and a good understanding of highly scalable distributed and cloud-native data stores.
Experience designing SaaS or highly scalable distributed applications on the cloud.
Financial management experience and ROI calculation.
Solutions Architect certification on a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

At 3Pillar, We Offer a World Of Opportunity

Imagine a flexible work environment - whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach.
You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English everyday. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.

new_jobs.title: Generalist, Product-Minded Software Engineer (Junior - Mid level)
new_jobs.description:
At Epignosis our mission is simple yet bold: To make learning technologies accessible to every business, regardless of geography, sector, or company size. And we've been doing just that for more than two decades, empowering millions of people to grow, learn, and thrive through technology that's both powerful and affordable.

We're rapidly becoming one of Greece's largest SaaS companies, serving 12,000+ companies and 22+ million learners worldwide with solutions like TalentLMS (an award-winning cloud LMS built for simplicity), eFront (an enterprise LMS), TalentCards (a mobile app for deskless training), and TalentHR (a lightweight HRIS for people operations).

Our success is built on a team that believes that work should matter — not only to you, but to the world around you. We're looking for people who light up when solving hard problems, who care deeply about their craft, and who want to build something that genuinely helps people grow.

We're looking for exceptional junior and mid-level Software Engineers who think beyond the code, care about the products they build, and love turning ideas into polished experiences. You'll thrive here if you're self-motivated and creative, combine strong engineering judgment with product thinking, learn quickly, and have a genuine feel for great UX and high-quality software.

You'll join a team that moves at a fast pace, delivering high-quality software while making thoughtful decisions that stand the test of time. We expect strong engineering skills for your experience level and will give you the opportunity to work hands-on with AI and emerging technologies.

Your work will span everything from early prototypes to products used by tens of thousands of organizations and millions of people worldwide — directly shaping how they learn, work, and grow.

Responsibilities

As a Generalist, Product-minded Software Engineer you will:

Own product development end-to-end—from understanding the problem and shaping the solution to building, launching, and iterating
Understand and analyze user and stakeholder feedback, translating it into practical product improvements
Turn ambiguous ideas into clear priorities, focused scopes, and working prototypes
Shape exceptional UI and user experiences across the product, with attention to clarity, consistency, and craft
Build across the stack, taking on frontend, backend, integrations, and infrastructure as needed
Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope to deliver value quickly
Collaborate closely with design, product, and business teams, contributing to both what we build and how we build it
Ship reliable, intuitive experiences and own testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance
Measure how products perform, learn from real usage, and take responsibility for outcomes

Requirements

To be successful in this role you should:

Be a builder. Turn ideas into working software—and have projects to show for it
Have a feel for great software and excellent UI/UX. Notice the details that make products intuitive and enjoyable to use
Think in terms of products. Understand the user's problem, question assumptions, and help decide what's worth building
Be an exceptional engineer for your experience level.

Bonus points for:

Experience across multiple technologies and programming paradigms
Familiarity with asynchronous programming
Open-source contributions you can point us to

Get your application noticed by including the following:

The things you've built. A GitHub profile, a portfolio, or a few good development war stories. Tell us what you built, what you owned, and what you learned. University assignments carry less weight unless they're complete projects you conceived and built independently
Your take on good and bad UX. Pick one product that gets it right and one that frustrates you. For bonus points: tell us why and what you'd change

Benefits

We've built a workplace where people can do the best work of their careers. Here's how we support that:

Competitive salary and bonuses. Strong base pay plus performance rewards at personal, team, and company levels
Stock options for everyone. Build software that empowers millions of learners worldwide, and own a piece of what you're creating. All team members can become shareholders, and these options have already changed lives
Your health is covered in more ways than one. Private health coverage for every team member, access to a nutritionist, and our in-house blood bank — all part of our health and wellness support
Comprehensive family support. We're proud of our progressive family policy, one of the most generous in Greece
Daily meals and food allowance. Breakfast and catered lunch at our offices, plus a monthly meal allowance you control
Commute covered. OASA transport card or parking space near the office, whichever works for your commute

Je komt terecht in ons Platform Team en bouwt mee aan de platformcomponenten waarop onze productteams vertrouwen. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat complexe uitdagingen rond schaalbaarheid, tenant isolation, messaging en deployments niet telkens opnieuw moeten worden opgelost.

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt platformcomponenten bovenop Azure en AKS.

Goede kennis van het Engels.

Werkomgeving

Het Nationaal Instituut voor Criminalistiek en Criminologie of kortweg het NICC is een federale wetenschappelijke instelling binnen de FOD Justitie. Op vraag van de gerechtelijke overheden verrichten ze onafhankelijk onderzoek.

De directie Criminalistiek identificeert en analyseert sporen van verdachten en modus operandi. Zo helpen we daders van misdrijven op te sporen en bewijslast op te bouwen. De directie Criminologie onderzoekt hoe het strafrechtelijke systeem functioneert en hoe we het kunnen verbeteren.

Taakomschrijving

De persoon zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het opzetten en ontwikkelen van applicaties voor onze verschillende wetenschappelijke laboratoria. Deze applicaties hebben betrekking op domeinen zoals drugs, toxicologie, ballistiek, DNA-analyse en criminologisch onderzoek. De kandidaat zal zich engageren vanuit een langetermijnperspectief en zal op termijn de back-up worden van ons Head of Development.

De kandidaat zal instaan voor het verzamelen van de behoeften en aanvragen van onze klanten en zal toezien op de correcte naleving van de deadlines van de projecten waarvoor hij/zij verantwoordelijk is.
Hij/zij zal instaan voor het onderhoud van de applicaties en zal daarnaast proactief meedenken en voorstellen formuleren ter ondersteuning van het IT-team.
Hij/zij zal eveneens toezien op de naleving van de vereisten inzake applicatiearchitectuur en veiligheid.
In bepaalde gevallen zal hij/zij externe teams aansturen die ondersteuning bieden bij de uitvoering van de projecten. In dat kader zal de kandidaat, afhankelijk van zijn/haar senioriteitsniveau (meer dan 5 jaar ervaring), ook instaan voor het interviewen en selecteren van externe medewerkers.

Profielomschrijving:

Een ervaren ontwikkelaar die AI gebruikt, moet diepgaande technische expertise combineren met het vermogen om AI-tools te orkestreren, methodologische nauwkeurigheid en geavanceerde ontwerpvaardigheden. De kern van het profiel: een pragmatische architect, prompt engineer, integrator en bewaker van kwaliteit.

Fundamentele technische competenties:

Programmeertalen & frameworks

Beheersing van een moderne backendprogrammeertaal: Python, C#, Java, Go, Node.js.
Beheersing van een frontendframework: React, Vue, Angular. Cloudarchitectuur: Azure, AWS, GCP.
Databases: geavanceerde SQL, optimalisatie, NoSQL, vector databases (Pinecone, Redis Vector).

Architectuur & ontwerp

Moderne design patterns (CQRS, Event Sourcing, Hexagonal Architecture).
Microservices en API's.
Applicatiebeveiliging: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust.
Observability/monitoring: gestructureerde logs, gedistribueerde traces en metrics.

Essentiële AI-competenties:

Geavanceerde prompt engineering

Structureren van prompts (rol → context → beperkingen → outputformaat).
Technieken: chain-of-thought, self-consistency, RAG en prompt guards.
Optimaliseren van de kwaliteit en verminderen van hallucinaties.

Integratie van AI in applicaties

Gebruik van LLM-API's: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic en Mistral
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): vectorisatie, embeddings en pipelines
AI-agents: orkestratie, tools en beveiliging
Fine-tuning: gespecialiseerde modellen en het samenstellen en beheren van datasets

AI-kwaliteit & governance

Evaluatie van modellen (BLEU, ROUGE, perplexity en menselijke evaluatie)
Detectie van bias, robuustheid en conformiteit met regelgeving en standaarden (NIS2, AVG/GDPR)
Implementatie van beveiligings- en controlemechanismen (guardrails, filtering en monitoring)

DevOps- en automatiseringscompetenties

Intelligente automatisering

CI/CD-processen versterkt door AI, zoals het genereren van pipelines, tests en documentatie
AI-ondersteunde refactoring: modernisering van legacycode.
Geautomatiseerde testen: unit tests, integratietesten en mutation testing:

Moderne tools

GitHub Copilot, GitHub en GitLab.
Docker en Kubernetes.

Specifieke competenties van een “AI-augmented” ontwikkelaar

Wat dit profiel werkelijk onderscheidt

Het vermogen om met behulp van AI betrouwbare code te genereren en deze vervolgens te auditen en optimaliseren.
Het creëren van AI-pipelines (prompt → test → verbetering → versionering).
Het gebruik van AI om het ontwerpproces te versnellen, bijvoorbeeld voor diagrammen, modellen en user stories.
Het automatiseren van repetitieve taken, zoals scripts, migraties, testen en documentatie.
Versnelde technologische monitoring: geautomatiseerde samenvattingen en vergelijking van oplossingen.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren: van cybersecurity-uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen ter ondersteuning van nieuwe manieren van werken tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je tegelijk werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en maximale kansen krijgt om je ambities waar te maken? Dan bieden wij:

Een duidelijke missie in een stimulerende werkomgeving
Een zeer competitief salarispakket met een uitgebreide waaier aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder:
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Maaltijdcheques
Mobiliteitsvoordelen
Pensioenfonds

Daarnaast hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, met telewerkmogelijkheden voor de meeste functies. Onze kantoren zijn bovendien zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer: Keystone Project (Machine-Verified LLM Inference)
new_jobs.description:
Mission

The Keystone project, an ARIA-funded collaboration between EPFL and Imperial College London, aims to build a formally-verified ML inference engine, demonstrating that AI can help make verified systems competitive with unverified systems in terms of development effort, features, and performance. Its missions include the design and implementation of verified inference components, the formalization of GPU kernel semantics, the development of AI-assisted proof engineering workflows, and the open-source release of specifications, proofs, and verified artefacts.

We seek an excellent software engineer to play a central role in turning verified research prototypes into a production-grade, high-performance inference engine. Prior experience with formal verification is welcome but not required: a strong systems engineer with the motivation to learn proof-assistant technology will thrive in this role.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Bring technical expertise in systems programming and performance engineering to support the project’s research; collaborate with the research teams at EPFL and Imperial College London
Design, implement, and maintain core components of the verified LLM inference engine, including the runtime and glue code connecting extracted verified code, GPU kernels, and drivers
Organize and manage the project’s engineering infrastructure: differential testing against reference engines (vLLM, SGLang), continuous integration for code and proofs, and performance benchmarking
Develop and maintain agentic AI pipelines for specification autoformalization, proof generation, and proof repair
Write documentation, procedures, and recommendations to ensure reproducibility of the project’s artefacts
Diagnose, prevent, and repair failures and regressions across the software stack
Analyze the security level and trusted computing base of the components we develop, and contribute to red/blue team exercises within the ARIA programme
Contribute to open-source releases and engage with their user communities

Profile

Higher degree in computer science or education deemed equivalent; experience in the field
Excellent technical knowledge of systems programming, and strong programming ability in several of: Python, C/C++, Rust, OCaml, or other functional languages
Knowledge of one or more of the following, with strong motivation to grow in the others:
GPU programming (CUDA, Triton, PTX) or high-performance computing
ML inference or serving systems (vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch internals, or similar)
Interactive theorem proving (Rocq, Lean, HOL, Isabelle, or similar) or other formal methods

Experience maintaining development tooling: build systems, continuous integration, and test infrastructure
Experience using LLM-based development tools or building agentic workflows is a plus
Mastery of English indispensable (oral and written); French is an asset but not required
Sense of priorities, integrity, and autonomy in your work
Team spirit and aptitude for conducting technical investigations and implementations; excellent ability to communicate with varied audiences, from proof engineers to systems researchers
Strong sense of service and spirit of initiative

We offer

The possibility to join a dynamic and stimulating team on a high-profile ARIA-funded project
A multicultural and academic working environment of high quality
Opportunities for continuing education and professional development
Excellent working conditions
Generous access to frontier AI models and high-performance compute
Funded travel for collaboration between Lausanne and London, and for conferences

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And In One PDF

A CV, including links to open-source contributions or representative projects where applicable.
Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: Nate Foster (nate.foster@epfl.ch).

More information can be found on https://laser.epfl.ch/.

new_jobs.title: Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
new_jobs.description:
En Provis
seguimos creciendo y queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, una persona con experiencia trabajando con aplicaciones web y APIs, capacidad para investigar y resolver incidencias técnicas y criterio para validar que una nueva versión está realmente preparada antes de llegar a nuestros clientes.

Buscamos un perfil técnico senior que disfrute entendiendo cómo funcionan las cosas, investigando problemas y trabajando cerca tanto de clientes como de los equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Si te gusta un entorno donde puedes tocar producto, soporte avanzado, QA, APIs, despliegues y cliente, este puesto puede ser para ti.

Únete a un equipo donde tu trabajo tiene impacto real

En Provis nos apasiona la tecnología y el fitness
por eso nos especializamos en la gestión de centros deportivos y cadenas de gimnasios.
Trabajamos en un entorno SaaS B2B en el que conviven aplicaciones web, APIs, aplicaciones móviles, software de gestión, pagos, reservas, control de accesos e integraciones con múltiples plataformas externas.
Nuestro día a día requiere personas con capacidad para entender el producto de forma global, tomar ownership de los problemas y colaborar con diferentes equipos hasta encontrar una solución.
No buscamos simplemente alguien que reciba una incidencia y la traslade.
Buscamos alguien que quiera entender qué está pasando, por qué está pasando y cómo podemos evitar que vuelva a ocurrir
.

Cómo será tu día a día

Como Técnico Senior Web, API & QA
, serás una de las referencias técnicas para nuestras soluciones Web y APIs.
Participarás en todo el ciclo de vida de nuestras soluciones: desde una incidencia reportada por un cliente hasta su análisis, escalado, validación de la solución y posterior despliegue.
Trabajarás estrechamente con nuestros equipos de Desarrollo, Sistemas, Producto y Soporte, además de tener contacto directo con clientes cuando sea necesario.
Es un puesto amplio por diseño.
Queremos una persona que pueda desenvolverse cómodamente entre Web, APIs, troubleshooting, QA, releases y soporte técnico avanzado
.

Lo que tendrás bajo tu responsabilidad

Analizar y resolver incidencias técnicas relacionadas con nuestras aplicaciones Web, APIs e integraciones.
Reproducir problemas reportados por clientes e investigar su causa antes de trasladarlos a Desarrollo.
Trabajar con APIs REST mediante herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares.
Analizar requests, responses, códigos HTTP, autenticación, logs y diferentes comportamientos de una aplicación.
Utilizar las herramientas de desarrollo del navegador para investigar incidencias Web.
Configurar, administrar y poner en marcha nuestras soluciones Web en nuevos clientes.
Realizar configuraciones y modificaciones sobre HTML y CSS cuando sea necesario.
Participar en despliegues y actualizaciones de aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Realizar QA funcional y betatesting de nuevas funcionalidades.
Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba para aplicaciones Web y APIs.
Validar correcciones antes de su publicación.
Realizar pruebas de regresión sobre funcionalidades críticas.
Participar en el proceso de publicación de nuevas versiones y en su validación antes de llegar a producción.
Probar nuevas versiones con clientes beta y realizar seguimiento después del despliegue.
Detectar riesgos o problemas antes de una publicación y comunicarlos de forma clara.
Gestionar y hacer seguimiento de incidencias de soporte técnico N2/N3.
Asegurar que las incidencias que llegan a Desarrollo contienen la información necesaria para analizarlas y reproducirlas.
Participar en reuniones de coordinación con Desarrollo para trasladar incidencias, prioridades y necesidades del cliente.
Hablar directamente con clientes cuando sea necesario para entender o resolver un problema.
Documentar actualizaciones, procedimientos, incidencias y configuraciones.
Compartir conocimiento con el resto del equipo y ayudar a mejorar nuestros procesos de soporte, QA y despliegue.

Lo que buscamos

Experiencia profesional trabajando con aplicaciones Web
.
Buenos conocimientos de HTML y CSS
.
Conocimiento del funcionamiento de una aplicación Web: HTTP, navegador, sesiones, cookies, caché, autenticación, etc.
Experiencia trabajando o realizando pruebas sobre APIs REST
.
Manejo de herramientas como Postman, Swagger o similares
.
Capacidad para utilizar DevTools y otras herramientas de diagnóstico.
Conocimientos de SQL que permitan investigar incidencias y trabajar con datos.
Experiencia investigando y resolviendo problemas técnicos.
Experiencia en QA, testing funcional, soporte técnico avanzado o validación de software.
Capacidad para estructurar y documentar correctamente una incidencia técnica.
Buena comunicación y comodidad tratando directamente con clientes.
Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y asumir responsabilidad sobre los temas que gestiona.
Mentalidad analítica, curiosidad técnica y ganas de entender cómo funcionan las cosas.

Nos encantará especialmente si además tienes experiencia en...

Entornos SaaS B2B.
Soporte técnico N2/N3 o Application Support.
Procesos de publicación y despliegue de software.
Git y procesos CI/CD.
Aplicaciones móviles.
Automatización de pruebas con Ranorex, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium o herramientas similares.
Integraciones entre diferentes plataformas mediante APIs.
Sistemas de ticketing y gestión de incidencias.
Trabajo con clientes técnicos o equipos de IT.
Inglés técnico.

Importante:
no esperamos que cumplas absolutamente todos los puntos.
Si tienes una buena base en Web/APIs, eres una persona técnica, resolutiva y con capacidad de aprendizaje, queremos conocerte.
Preferimos encontrar una gran persona con capacidad para crecer que un CV que simplemente marque todas las casillas.

¿Por qué puede ser un gran siguiente paso?

Este no es un puesto donde te limitarás a realizar siempre la misma función.
Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar de extremo a extremo:
Cliente → incidencia → diagnóstico → Desarrollo → QA → release → producción.

Eso significa:
Autonomía real.
Problemas técnicos diferentes cada día.
Contacto directo con Desarrollo, Sistemas y Producto.
Visibilidad sobre cómo funciona una plataforma SaaS compleja.
Capacidad para proponer cambios y mejorar procesos.
Posibilidad de convertirte en una referencia técnica dentro del área Web y APIs.
Participación directa en proyectos e implantaciones para algunos de nuestros principales clientes.

¿Por qué ProviSport?

Somos la empresa líder en tecnológica especializada en el sector fitness y deportivo.
Nuestro software es utilizado diariamente por cadenas de gimnasios, centros deportivos y millones de usuarios, y seguimos evolucionando nuestra plataforma, nuestras APIs y nuestras aplicaciones para acompañar el crecimiento de nuestros clientes.
Estamos en un momento en el que queremos seguir elevando nuestro nivel técnico, mejorar nuestros procesos de QA y despliegue y construir una organización cada vez más sólida y escalable.
Por eso buscamos personas que quieran aportar, cuestionar, mejorar y asumir responsabilidad
.

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer in Test
new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

Spend your days making a difference, not just working for a living. At Diligent, we build Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Audit software that helps uncover fraud, waste, environmental risks, and abuse in organizations. Our collaborative R&D teams build and scale a SaaS platform using AWS technologies—delivering AI-powered solutions that support Modern Governance and drive meaningful impact.

As a Staff Software Engineer in Test, you’ll take ownership of quality assurance across an entire program, spanning multiple Scrum teams and involving both QA analysts and engineers. Your responsibility goes beyond manual and automated testing—you will define and drive quality across the full development lifecycle, advocate for shift-left principles, and enable rapid, safe delivery. In addition to your test engineering and automation expertise, you will champion AI-augmented quality practices, leveraging modern tools and governance principles to enhance testing coverage, efficiency, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Lead testing strategy and execution across complex microservices and frontend/backend architectures (AWS, .NET, Angular, APIs, etc.)
Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, integrating seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines (Playwright, AWS CDK), with a DevSecOps mindset
Pioneer the use of AI-driven testing solutions—evaluate and implement intelligent test generation, defect prediction, and adaptive test strategies using LLMs and other AI models
Apply responsible AI practices by embedding bias detection, safety validation, and explainability checks into QA processes and automation
Collaborate across teams to ensure quality is built-in from the start, promoting a shift-left mindset and influencing engineering practices
Use observability tools and data analytics to identify systemic issues and improve performance, coverage, and resilience
Lead test strategy reviews, architecture discussions, and mentor engineers in automation, AI-enhanced QA workflows, and testing best practices
Stay up to date with AI trends, tools, and regulations; adapt test strategies accordingly to support compliance, security, and innovation

Required Experience/Skills

7+ years in software engineering in test roles within commercial software environments
Strong expertise in TypeScript, Playwright, or a similar end-to-end testing tool, with a willingness to develop deep expertise in Playwright
Proven experience with API and backend testing, including microservices and monolithic systems
Experience designing automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
Familiarity with AWS serverless services and modern DevOps practices (IaC, Docker, observability tools)
Exposure to security principles in delivery pipelines (IAM, secrets management, DevSecOps)
Strong understanding of AI in software engineering, such as: Using LLMs to assist with test generation and defect triage Embedding monitoring and validation around AI components Designing QA strategies for AI-infused systems (e.g., prompt testing, model input/output verification)
Exceptional communication skills and experience mentoring or leading others in a quality or test leadership capacity

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

What Diligent Offers You

Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time.
